description: All JSON-LD blocks on a page, parsed and indexed by schema.org type, with an optional type filter and a microdata fallback. Use this to read product, price, article or event data without writing a scraper. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base.

type.description: Return only nodes of this @type, e.g. Product.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to process.
